title: Move-Out and Deposit Office Note: Security Share on Payable Held Utility Charges
content:
# Security Share on the Payable Part — Utility Services Program

**Note.** Where part of the held charges of a Utility Services Program account stays payable during a submitted dispute, that payable part is reduced by a security share set by the cash deposit held on the lease's Security Deposit Account:

| Cash deposit held on the Security Deposit Account | Security share |
|---|---|
| at least the Apartment Home Lease's monthly rent | 0.50 |
| held, but below the monthly rent | 0.75 |
| no cash deposit held | the whole payable part (1.0) |

The payable part is multiplied by the share; the product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Reading the records

- The cash deposit held is the amount the Security Deposit Account records as held for the lease.
- The monthly rent is the rent recorded on the Apartment Home Lease.

## Cases (hypothetical payable part of $43.02, monthly rent $1,800.00)

- Cash deposit held $1,800.00: equal to the rent, share 0.50; $21.51.
- Cash deposit held $900.00: share 0.75; $32.265, which is $32.27 when rounded at the end.
- No cash deposit held: $43.02.
